scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @novel-tool/api" "npm run dev -w @novel-tool/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @novel-tool/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run check:arch && npm run check:crawler && npm run check:web-arch && npm run check:web-contracts && npm run format:check && npm run check -w packages/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run check -w apps/api && npm run check -w apps/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && node --experimental-sqlite --import tsx --test tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check:lockfile && npm run check && npm run test:regression && npm run test:integration && npm run build
